args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE transparent SQUARE animation key-pose sheet, exactly SIX columns by SIX rows,36 equal cells with generous clear gutters, no labels/borders. Input1 is original anatomy authority; input2 original face/expression authority. Create the SAME recognizable Victamin throughout: a limbless cheerleader paper-pompom rabbit, exactly TWO long oval cream ears (left orange inside, right yellow), broad overlapping cream-white rectangular paper tabs with butter-yellow/apricot accents, two orange square cheeks, tiny dark-brown eyes and small mouth. No arms/hands/legs/feet/fur/clothes/hat. Warm clean matte cel illustration, crisp taupe contours and sparse broad seams matching a cream calendar. Use large native resolution. Whole body including ears stays inside each cell, consistent apparent scale/ground baseline88%, genuine alpha, NO ground/shadows/text/extra props. Three-quarter toward right unless rotation is required; preserve rectangular tabs around the whole body in rotated poses, never expose skin or a second face.
Read left-to-right, each ROW is six successive purposeful key poses:
1. RUN: lean forward; compress; spring forward; airborne ears trail; touch down; rebound. Fast eager bouncing locomotion without legs.
2. TUMBLE: surprised forward stumble; body tips45degrees; rolls onto side110degrees; rounded back/top rotates210degrees with face naturally occluded; rolls310degrees; lands upright a little crumpled. Not the identical front face simply rotated.
3. DIZZY/RECOVER: off-balance; dazed spiral eyes; unsteady tilted ears; brisk head shake left; head shake right; clear-eyed relieved upright. No external stars/text, character alone.
4. SLIP/BUMP/LOOK: backward slip; safe soft flattened landing; startled stop; sheepish glance left; sheepish glance right; shy lowered ears looking at viewer.
5. FEELINGS: surprised watery eyes; softly teary lower eyelids; two small tears and tiny trembling mouth; quiet sulk with three short comic stress strokes near eyes; drooping sad ears; recovering soft hopeful gaze. Lovable mild cartoon emotion, no injuries/violence or hand.
6. PLAY: eager play-bow front lowered; happy upright rebound; nuzzling own paper layers to groom without hands; ears smooth into place; focused crouching pounce; delighted midair pounce.
These36 newly drawn coherent key poses must match one design, not unrelated characters. No motion blur, fuzzy microdetail, pixel dithering, glow, background or lettering.
